deviceClass: Robotic Vacuum Cleaner with Auto-Empty, Auto-Wash, Auto-Refill, Auto-Dry Dock
primaryComponents: DuoRoller Riser Main Brush Assembly (2 counter-rotating rubber brushes, motorized, liftable)
VibraRise 2.0 Mopping Module (Vibrating mop pad, motorized for lifting)
PreciSense LiDAR Navigation System (Top-mounted rotating laser sensor)
Reactive 3D Obstacle Avoidance System (Front-mounted structured light sensor/camera)
Dust Collection Port and Suction Motor (for auto-emptying)
Mop Washing Basin with Scrubber Brushes and Water Jets (Dock)
Warm Air Drying Fan and Heating Element (Dock)
Water Pumps and Hoses (Dock, for auto-refill/drainage)
operationalLogic: The robot navigates its environment using LiDAR for mapping and Reactive 3D for real-time obstacle avoidance. It moves via two independently driven wheels and cleans floors in a systematic pattern. For dry cleaning, a powerful suction fan draws debris into the dustbin, assisted by dual counter-rotating rubber brushes that agitate and lift dirt, and a side brush that sweeps edges. For wet cleaning, a vibrating mop module scrubs the floor with water from an internal tank (replenished by the dock). When encountering carpet, the mop module automatically lifts. Upon returning to the RockDock Ultra, the robot automatically empties its dustbin into a disposable bag, refills its internal clean water tank, empties its dirty water, washes its mop pad using integrated brushes and water, and then dries the mop pad with warm air. The internal battery is simultaneously recharged via the dock's charging contacts.
maintenanceNodes: DuoRoller Riser Main Brushes (Cleaning hair/debris, periodic replacement)
RockDock Ultra Mop Washing Basin (Cleaning debris)
Reactive 3D Obstacle Avoidance Sensor Window (Wiping clean)
Drive Wheels and Caster Wheel (Cleaning hair/debris)
